name: StockX
tagline: StockX seller fee calculator: 9% to 7% transaction fee by level, 3% processing, $5 shipping, and your payout.
fee_summary: StockX charges a transaction fee of 9% (Level 1) down to 7% (Level 5) of the final sale price, with a $5 minimum, plus a 3% payment processing fee. US sellers also pay a $5.00 shipping fee on each Verified Marketplace sale, deducted from the payout.

fees.label: Transaction fee
fees.note: 9% at Level 1, 8.5% at Level 2, 8% at Level 3, 7.5% at Level 4, 7% at Level 5, calculated on the final sale price. Minimum $5.00 for US sellers.

fees.label: Payment processing fee
fees.note: 3% of the final sale price on the Verified Marketplace, at every seller level.

fees.label: Seller shipping fee
fees.note: $5.00 per Verified Marketplace sale for US sellers, deducted from the payout ($4.00 before March 1, 2026).

worked_example.explanation: A Level 1 seller sells a pair of sneakers for $180. The transaction fee is 9% of $180 = $16.20 (above the $5 minimum), payment processing is 3% of $180 = $5.40, and the seller shipping fee is $5.00, so fees total $26.60. The payout is $180.00 − $26.60 = $153.40. After the $120 the seller paid at retail, profit is $33.40. The buyer pays their own shipping separately.

content.intro:
StockX is a bid/ask marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, trading cards, collectibles, and electronics. Sellers list an Ask or accept a Bid, ship the item to StockX for verification, and StockX forwards it to the buyer. Sellers range from people flipping a single retail pair to high-volume resellers moving hundreds of pairs a quarter.

Three deductions come out of every Verified Marketplace sale. The transaction fee depends on your seller level: 9% at Level 1, 8.5% at Level 2, 8% at Level 3, 7.5% at Level 4, and 7% at Level 5, with a $5.00 minimum for US sellers. Levels are earned by quarterly volume: Level 2 needs 12 sales or $1,500, Level 3 needs 40 sales or $5,000, Level 4 needs 200 sales or $25,000, and Level 5 needs 800 sales or $100,000. Once you reach a level, you keep it through the current quarter and the following one.

The second is 3% payment processing, charged at every level. Both percentages are calculated on the final sale price. The third is a flat seller shipping fee, $5.00 for US sellers, which StockX deducts from your payout; it was $4.00 before March 1, 2026. The buyer pays their own shipping and any sales tax at checkout, and neither is part of your fee base.

On a $180 pair at Level 1, fees are $16.20 plus $5.40 plus the $5.00 shipping fee, and you receive $153.40. The same sale at Level 5 pays $157.00. StockX's newer Listings Marketplace and StockX Live charged sellers no standard selling or processing fees at launch, with buyers covering those costs instead.
how_fees_work: Transaction fee: a percentage of the final sale price set by your seller level. Level 1 is 9%, Level 2 is 8.5%, Level 3 is 8%, Level 4 is 7.5%, Level 5 is 7%.
Minimum transaction fee: $5.00 for US sellers. It only matters on cheap items: below about $56 at Level 1, the $5 minimum is more than 9%.
Payment processing fee: 3% of the final sale price, charged on every Verified Marketplace sale regardless of level.

Seller levels: earned on a calendar-quarter basis by either sales count or dollar volume (Level 2: 12 sales or $1,500; Level 3: 40 or $5,000; Level 4: 200 or $25,000; Level 5: 800 or $100,000). A level you reach applies for the rest of that quarter and the next one.
Seller shipping fee: $5.00 per Verified Marketplace sale for US sellers, deducted from your payout. It was $4.00 before March 1, 2026; other countries have their own rates.
Buyer shipping and tax: the buyer pays their own shipping and any sales tax at checkout; they are not part of your fee base. You ship the item to a StockX verification center.

Listings Marketplace and StockX Live: at launch, StockX charged sellers no standard selling or processing fees on these formats; the buyer covers the processing fee and shipping. Penalty and return-related fees can still apply.
tips: Chase the next level near quarter end. Going from Level 1 to Level 2 saves 0.5% on every sale for the rest of that quarter and all of the next; on $5,000 of quarterly sales that is $25.
Watch the $5 minimum on low-value items. A $30 sale pays a $5.00 transaction fee (16.7%), $0.90 processing and the $5.00 shipping fee, so $10.90 of it (about 36%) goes to fees.
Price Asks with the full 12% plus the $5 shipping fee in mind at Level 1. To clear a $30 profit on a $120 retail pair, your Ask needs to be $176.13 or higher.

Compare with GOAT before you list. GOAT's 9.5% commission plus a $5 mailing fee and 2.9% cash-out fee often comes out close to StockX's 12% plus $5 shipping, but the ranking flips as your StockX level rises.
Sell to existing Bids when the spread is small. The fee percentage is the same either way, and selling now avoids the risk of the market dropping while your Ask sits.

faq.q: What are StockX seller fees in 2026?
faq.a: A transaction fee of 9% (Level 1), 8.5% (Level 2), 8% (Level 3), 7.5% (Level 4), or 7% (Level 5) of the sale price, with a $5 minimum, plus a 3% payment processing fee and, for US sellers, a $5.00 shipping fee per sale.

faq.q: Does StockX charge sellers for shipping?
faq.a: Yes. On Verified Marketplace sales StockX deducts a seller shipping fee from your payout: $5.00 for US sellers, up from $4.00 since March 1, 2026. The buyer pays their own shipping separately at checkout.

faq.q: How much does StockX take on a $200 sale?
faq.a: At Level 1, 9% ($18.00) plus 3% ($6.00) plus the $5.00 shipping fee = $29.00, leaving $171.00. At Level 3 it is $27.00 in fees and a $173.00 payout.

faq.q: What is the minimum StockX seller fee?
faq.a: $5.00 for US sellers. If your level's percentage of the sale price is less than $5, you pay $5 for the transaction fee; the 3% processing fee and the $5.00 shipping fee are added on top.

faq.q: How do I get a lower fee on StockX?
faq.a: Move up seller levels. Level 2 needs 12 sales or $1,500 in a calendar quarter, Level 3 needs 40 sales or $5,000, Level 4 needs 200 sales or $25,000, and Level 5 needs 800 sales or $100,000.

faq.q: Does StockX charge a fee to buyers?
faq.a: Yes, buyers pay a processing fee and shipping at checkout. Those are separate from the seller's transaction and processing fees.

Payouts are released after the item passes verification at a StockX facility and are sent to your linked payout method; the exact timing depends on the payout method and is listed in the StockX Help Center.

content.notes: Fee percentages and level requirements verified on the StockX Help Center. The $5.00 US minimum is described there as a 'minimum seller fee' and is applied here to the transaction fee. The seller shipping fee is from the Help Center article on seller shipping costs, which lists $5.00 for US sellers (single item and bulk) and says the cost is deducted from the payout on Verified Marketplace sales; StockX's February 24, 2026 news post says it rose from $4 to $5 for US sellers on standard, non-Flex sales starting March 1, 2026. This calculator has included the shipping fee since October 9, 2026. The same post raised Flex transaction fees by 2 points at every level, to the 9% to 7% scale, removed the $5 Flex fulfillment fee and ended Early Seller Payout on standard sales; Flex sales are not modeled. The Help Center fee page carries no update date; the level fees shown differ from the 2023 announcement (which listed 9% base with bonus reductions), so treat the Help Center figures as current. The 2023 announcement was not re-read for this update and keeps its earlier access date. Payout timing by payout method was not verified on an official page for this update. Listings Marketplace and StockX Live fee statements are 'at launch' and may change; this calculator models the Verified Marketplace only. Occasional promotions (for example, limited-time 0% processing) are not modeled.

changelog.change: StockX raised the seller shipping fee on standard (non-Flex) sales from $4 to $5 for US sellers and raised Flex transaction fees by 2 points at every level (announced February 24, 2026).
StockX lowered the base transaction fee by 1% across all seller levels, to 9% at Level 1 (announced June 1, 2023).
